final_draft.answer: Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. Our Access Control Policy also requires all workforce members to authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.
final_draft.note: This only partly answers the question, which asks about contractors. The approved answer (CC6.1) covers employees only. Policy section 4.2 says 'all workforce members', but no source we found defines that term or says contractors are included. So the draft doesn't state that contractors are covered. Before sending, the owner (security@harborlight.example) should confirm whether contractors count as workforce members. If they do, the answer can say so directly. This answer is based on approved text and policy only. We didn't check live settings, because none of the available live checks covers the identity provider's MFA enforcement.
